headlines.title: 서울 아파트 전셋값 39개월째 상승 … 강북 첫 6억 돌파
headlines.summary: 10월 전세 7.2억, 4년전 고점보다 높아 강북 평균 6억281만원, 강남 8.4억원 서울과 전국 격차 3.36억→3.9억 확대 서울 강남구 부동산에 게시된 매매 및 전세 게시물.  [연합] 서울 아파트 평균 전세가격이 39개월 연속 상승하면서, 7억2898만원으로 사상 최대치를 경신했다. 강북 14개구 전세 가격은 처음으로 6억원을 넘겼다.

headlines.title: 경유 수출제한 완화 추진 … 업계, 해외수요 대응 기대감
headlines.summary: ‘전년의 100%’ 기준 조정 시사 경유 부족한 국가로 반출 숨통 정부가 경유 수출 물량 제한 완화를 추진하면서 정유업계의 기대감이 커지고 있다. 업계는 국내 공급에 문제가 없고 생산량도 회복됐다면서 규제 완화가 재고 부담을 덜고 해외 수요에 대응할 수 있는 계기가 될 것으로 기대하고 있다.

headlines.title: 실적 양극화 … 건설·배터리 등 산업계 곳곳 인력 감축
headlines.summary: 장기침체에 희망퇴직·전환 배치 기업 경기전망, 2개월째 부정적 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 역대급 실적을 바탕으로 초대형 주주환원에 나서고 있지만, 실적이 저조한 산업계 일각에서는 희망퇴직과 인력 재배치 등 구조조정이 잇따르고 있다. 반도체 부문만 호실적을 내는 K자형 양극화가 고용 현장에서도 나타나는 모습이다.

key_headlines.title: Pohang AI Data Center Construction Accelerates with 600 Billion Won Investment
key_headlines.summary: Gyeongbuk province is supporting a 40 billion won investment in a global AI data center expected to generate 1.2 trillion won in production and create 4,000 jobs by January 2028.

key_headlines.title: Consumer Credit Interest Rates Surge to 6.33% Despite Economic Growth
key_headlines.summary: Credit loan rates jumped from 5.41% to 6.33%, with mortgage rates rising 0.7 percentage points, creating hardship for ordinary citizens despite third-quarter GDP exceeding expectations.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Jeonse Prices Hit Record High at 728.98 Million Won for 39 Consecutive Months
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment jeonse (lease deposit) prices reached an all-time high of 728.98 million won, with Northern Seoul exceeding 600 million won for the first time.

key_headlines.title: Fed Maintains Base Rate at 3.75-4% While Korea Faces Continued Rate Hike Pressure
key_headlines.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve held rates steady with a 93.4% probability, but the Bank of Korea is likely to continue its tightening stance amid persistent inflation concerns.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Boom Triggers K-Shaped Polarization with Workforce Reductions Across Industries
key_headlines.summary: While Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix announce record earnings and major shareholder returns, other industries face restructuring with voluntary retirements and workforce realignment.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy shows mixed signals with robust semiconductor and technology sectors contrasting sharply with struggling traditional industries. Third-quarter GDP growth exceeded expectations with a 1.0% quarter-over-quarter increase, yet consumer sentiment remains weak with credit loan rates surging to 6.33%. The real estate market continues to surge with Seoul apartment jeonse prices hitting record highs at 728.98 million won after 39 consecutive months of increases. Employment conditions reveal a K-shaped polarization, with semiconductor companies posting record profits and shareholder returns while construction, battery, and other industries implement workforce reductions and restructuring.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea maintains pressure for additional rate hikes despite the U.S. Federal Reserve holding base rates at 3.75-4%. Korea's monetary policy divergence from the Fed reflects persistent domestic inflation concerns, with October inflation expected to rebound to around 3%. Bank of Korea analysis indicates carbon neutrality policies will reduce annual GDP growth by approximately 0.06 percentage points through 2060. The government continues to support regional development, including the Pohang AI data center project with 40 billion won in provincial investment targeting 2028 operations and 4,000 job creation.
sections.Financial Markets: U.S. equity markets rose modestly following the Fed's rate hold, with semiconductor stocks leading gains and the Nasdaq up 72.04 points. Bond markets are pricing in a 90% probability of December rate increases, pushing two-year Treasury yields to 4.76%. The Korean won strengthened to the 1,330 level following the Fed's 'less hawkish' stance than anticipated. Corporate business sentiment improved to its highest level in 50 months (104.2) due to reduced geopolitical uncertainty and strong performance in semiconductors, automobiles, and shipbuilding sectors.
sections.Industry & Technology: Major semiconductor companies Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are driving record earnings and shareholder returns, with positive sentiment spreading to supply chain industries. The corporate sentiment index reached its highest point in 50 months, reflecting strong production and investment growth in semiconductors, automobiles, and shipbuilding. Smaller companies and domestic-focused businesses also exceeded long-term averages. The government is promoting seven strategic SEED projects including nuclear fusion, renewable energy, and advanced biotechnology, strengthening linkages between science and economic policy.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment market continues to boom with jeonse prices reaching 728.98 million won, the highest level in history, after 39 consecutive months of increases. Northern Seoul jeonse prices surpassed 600 million won for the first time, while Southern Seoul averages 840 million won, expanding the regional gap to 3.9 billion won. Seoul's new apartment supply in 2026 is projected at 17,698 units, the lowest in 13 years, creating severe supply constraints and raising entry barriers for homebuyers. Premium branded apartments with strong developer backing remain attractive for reconstruction investment, though buyers face concerns about construction delays and internal conflicts.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. is expanding national security investigations to new product categories, including wind turbines and industrial robots, potentially introducing additional tariffs on Korean exporters. The Trump administration has directed negotiations with major trading partners following preliminary findings that U.S. imports depend heavily on foreign suppliers. Fed Chair Kevin Powell praised Korea's advanced technology sector and mentioned his relationship with Bank of Korea officials during FOMC press conferences. These protectionist measures create new trade uncertainties for Korean companies in clean energy and industrial equipment sectors.
sections.AI & Economy: Microsoft reported quarterly revenue of 92.28 billion dollars (124 trillion won), up 19% year-over-year, driven by strong AI and cloud services growth, with Azure expanding 48%. Samsung SDI predicts the battery backup unit market will grow at an average annual rate of 30% through 2030 as AI GPU demand increases. Hancom unveiled an AI-powered workplace platform with 12 AI team members for U.S. market penetration. Puriosia AI secured 820 billion won in funding at a 3.8 trillion won valuation from the National Growth Fund and other investors, highlighting strong venture capital interest in Korean AI companies.
sections.Others: Korea's total pension system is expanding with mandatory external reserve requirements for all workplaces by 2030 and private financial institution participation in fund-type retirement pensions. Government agencies coordinate science and economic policies through the seven SEED future industry projects. Financial companies received awards for fintech innovation, including NH Investment & Securities' Namu MTS platform and Koscom's ETF CHECK service for promoting financial inclusion. The government emphasizes stepped implementation of mandatory pension provisions considering small business needs.
